def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    seqs={'B':g[-1],'T':g[0]}
    for i in range(H-1):
        for j,v in enumerate(g[i]):

                # choose seq containing v
                cand=[s for k,s in seqs.items() if s and v in s]
                if not cand: continue
                s=cand[0]; L=len(s); idx=s.index(v)
                start=j-idx
                if start<0: start=0
                end=min(start+L,W)
                out[i][start:end]=[s[k] for k in range(end-start)]
    return out

            if 0<=col<W: O[i][col]=x
    return O
